guidance.statement: Blended EBITDA margin expectation for the year is 50% to 55%
guidance.quote: My expectation as a blended for the year, roughly about 50% to 55% is our hope for the year.
guidance.speaker: Vipul Joshi

growth_commentary: Executed around 40% of the open order book of Q3 in Q4, recording highest ever quarterly revenue and profit after tax.
Order booking momentum converted into execution, including acceptance of delivered electronic warfare resilience capability with real-world testing.
Opening order book for FY27 stood at approximately INR310 crores.

pushback.question: What sort of pipeline we have and what sort of inflow we are expecting in FY27 and what percentage of your order book we are expecting to execute in FY27?
pushback.answer: The open order book of about INR310 crores is slated for execution in FY27 itself, primarily in the first three quarters.

pushback.question: What is the latest update on ammunition licenses if you're entering into this long-range target drones?
pushback.answer: We do not intend to take those licenses even today and are partnering with handlers of munitions traditionally for the government.

pushback.question: Which specific subsystems or components are most at risk based on the current geopolitical side?
pushback.answer: Thermal imagers remain a constrained challenge for everyone at this point in time because of multiple reasons.
